verdict_reason: Rename and new roles component are correct, but roles has two wire representations for 'none' (null or empty), pushing null guards into every consumer.

todos.issue: roles goes out on the wire as either null or an empty list for an address with no roles (schema description at :51-52 'null or empty when it has none'; compact constructor :73-85 leaves roles untouched; AddressMapperTest:79 and AddressResponseTest:64 pin null). Two representations of 'none' push the normalisation into every consumer: ins-frontend view-model/list.js:46 '(roles ?? [])' and services/address-book/stub.js:73 '(address.roles ?? [])' each repeat it. AddressRequest already owns the same rule for input (AddressRequest.java:122 'roles == null ? List.of() : ...'), so the response is the one side without an owner.
todos.fix: Must: an AddressResponse's roles is never null on the wire; an address with no roles reads as an empty list, normalised once in the API, and the schema description and class Javadoc say so. One way: in the compact constructor set 'roles = roles == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(roles)', mark the @ArraySchema REQUIRED, change the description to 'empty when it has none', drop roles from the Javadoc's optional-field list, update AddressMapperTest:79 / AddressResponseTest:64 to assert isEmpty(), regenerate docs/openapi, and let the frontend drop its '?? []' guards.
